integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic fashion film. <Subject 1> walks down the runway at the ballroom of a crumbling palace in an ontologically draped, melancholic baroque look from Atelier Sans Titre: sleeves that forget where the arm ends in moss velvet. The camera tracks the moving subject at slow speed. Camera flashes burst from both sides while the front row watches in total silence. [Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 1> stopping at the end of the runway, holding a blank stare for a beat, then turning away. The camera holds a static shot.

overall_soundscape: Sharp heel strikes on a hard floor and a rapid ripple of camera shutters. A single cough in the audience.

non_diegetic_music: A heavy techno pulse at a slow tempo with a distorted kick drum.
